title: Arcads vs Hiring an Agency: When to Switch and What Changes
summary: Arcads ads flopped? Check why first. This guide compares Arcads with an agency on briefs, presenters, rights and credits, with terms checked October 2026.
body_markdown:
Hire an agency when the gap is making and approving finished ads, not when the tool itself is the problem. Knowlify, our top pick for teams that want finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, makes the ads for you, a person checks each one, and it can run your Meta campaigns if you want that too. Arcads gives you software and credits so you can make the ads yourself, so the switch only makes sense once you know what failed.


Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared. The comparison uses public pages checked in October 2026 rather than hands-on output tests, so treat the figures as published terms.


## Find out why the ads flopped before you switch


A flop usually traces to one of four things: the offer, the hook, the presenter or the test. Test the cheap fixes first, because a new presenter will not rescue an offer nobody wants. Meta's delivery system stays in a[learning phase](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/112167992830700) until an ad set can deliver stably, which Meta says, as of October 2026, usually happens after about 50 results in the week after the ad set's last significant edit. An ad judged after two days, or edited every morning, tells you very little.


Credits make every retake expensive. As of October 2026,[Arcads' credit schedule](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/13725589-how-are-credits-counted) charges talking-actor generation at 800 credits per rounded-up minute per actor, plus 80 credits for captions and 240 for translation. Our[Arcads pricing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/arcads-pricing-and-alternatives) explains the plans. A script that needs three rewrites costs three generations before you count your review time.


If the offer and hook are sound and the ads still lose, a hiring decision is reasonable. If the script is a rough first draft, fix the brief first.

### Knowlify: our top pick when production is the bottleneck


Knowlify is our top pick for a team leaving a self-serve tool because it moves the production work Arcads leaves with you, producing the ads and checking them, to someone else. It makes about 25 finished ads a week in three formats (AI UGC, 3D and character animation, and AI commercials), the first batch lands on day five, and a person checks every ad before delivery. Buy creative only if you already have a media buyer, or have Knowlify run your[Meta campaigns](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) end to end. Knowlify (YC S25, founded 2025 and based in San Francisco) is a done-for-you AI video ads agency for Facebook and Instagram.


Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card. The guarantee limits the risk of switching: if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. Knowlify's named clients are Parva and Casco, and its[video ad examples page](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) shows finished work.


**When to pick another option:** if you need a real person on camera or ads run from a creator's handle. Meta's[partnership ads documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/ad-creative/partnership-ads) describes partnership ads as running from a creator's or partner's handle, which an AI presenter cannot provide.


### Creatify Studio: managed AI video at a per-video price


As of October 2026,[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is a managed service in which a creative team handles strategy, scripting and production. A person reviews every ad, and the Studio page lists 25 to 100 or more videos a month with a 48-hour turnaround. Its comparison table puts the cost at $100 to $200 per video. Creatify's self-serve plans, from $15 a month on[its pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) , are a different product, and the Studio page does not say whether it runs campaigns.


**Consider it when** you want to keep the brief and approvals in-house and hand over production.


### Brighter Click and Insense: real creators on a known price


As of October 2026,[Brighter Click](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) sells 12 edited videos from 4 creators for $4,500, with full usage rights in perpetuity.[Insense](https://insense.pro/services/ready-to-go-ugc-videos) sells managed rounds of 8 video ads from $3,500 on a 3-month commitment, with creator costs included, 2 revisions after delivery and full digital usage rights across channels. Both fit an ad that needs a real creator on camera.


**Consider it when** the ad needs a real creator, and a known price matters more to you than an AI presenter's speed.


### The UGC Agency: creators, with your team running the media


As of October 2026,[The UGC Agency](https://theugc.agency/) is a London-based company with a network of more than 30,000 creators. Its first round of finished ads has a 21-day target, and each stage is approved before the next. It does not run media: your team or agency runs the ads, though it sets up creator-handle ads. Usage is agreed with each creator, and pricing is not published.


**Consider it when** you already have a media buyer and want creator ads with usage agreed creator by creator.
